results.title: Justification of Estimates for Appropriations Committees ...
results.content:  The Office of Operations provides frontline and support services to millions of customers each year and completes our program integrity (PI) work, ensuring we pay the right person the right amount at the right time: o Over 1,200 field offices handle benefit claims, appeals, and post-entitlement events; process applications for Social Security cards; enroll people in Medicare; and address urgent needs and questions from visitors and callers; o Our 24 teleservice centers answer a broad range of Social Security and Medicare questions; schedule appointments with our field offices; provide status updates on current claims or appeals; and ensure the accuracy of our records; o Our 10 regional offices around the country oversee and support our frontline offices across the nation; and o Our 8 processing centers (PC) handle the most complex benefit payment decisions, issue benefit payments after appeals decisions, determine and collect debt, correct records, and perform PI work.
